purpose: Переплести уже исследованные ветви JANUS — атом/Дети Атома, квантовое branching и декогеренцию, реальные ядерно-UAP регистры, Fallout 3 birthday/rebirth motifs, Mothership Zeta birthday residue и identity/memory investigations — в одну многослойную модель без смешения доказательности.

central_thread.compressed: DIVISION → MULTIPLICITY → DECOHERENCE/SEPARATION → PERSISTENT RECORDS → OBSERVATION → INTERPRETATION
central_thread.critical_boundary: Эта общая структура не означает тождество между ядерным делением, Everett branching, Fallout theology и UAP.
central_thread.why_this_thread_exists: В разных реестрах повторяется один структурный мотив: событие разделяет возможное/состояния/объекты и оставляет след, который позднее становится частью новой истории.

L0_symbolic_foundation.title: Atom as indivisible / Atom as generative whole
L0_symbolic_foundation.legacy_claim: Исторический атомный реестр удерживает аксиому неделимости как этико-философский предел.
L0_symbolic_foundation.children_of_atom: В Fallout 3 Children of Atom превращают разделение атомной массы в метафизическое разделение/рождение миров.

L1_fallout_cosmology.title: Division as creation
L1_fallout_cosmology.claim: Внутри Fallout lore Children of Atom утверждают, что атомная масса содержит вселенную, а её разделение порождает новые вселенные.

L2_quantum_physics.title: Entanglement and decoherence
L2_quantum_physics.source_note: 2026 PRL work studies angular-momentum generation and entanglement in fission fragments.
L2_quantum_physics.boundary: Entanglement and decoherence do not directly establish independently observable classical universes.

L3_everett.title: Branching interpretation
L3_everett.claim: Everettian MWI describes a universal quantum state whose macroscopic structure can be represented by branching quasi-classical worlds.
L3_everett.boundary: MWI is an interpretation/ontology of quantum theory; a branch is not a small object flying away from a fission event.

L4_environment.title: Persistent physical history
L4_environment.interpretation: A nuclear event can reshape many subsequent degrees of freedom and leave a long-lived record.
L4_environment.boundary: A persistent environmental record is not a detector of another universe.

L5_uap_observation.title: Nuclear context as an empirical observation layer
L5_uap_observation.structure: facts / UAP incidents / preregistered statistics / isolated speculation
L5_uap_observation.boundary: Association with nuclear sites/events does not by itself establish extraterrestrial or inter-universal origin.

L6_fallout_birthday.title: Birthday as life-cycle / identity transition artifact
L6_fallout_birthday.interpretive_bridge: Birth, transformation, identity absorption, aging and death form a closed life-cycle motif.

L7_mothership_zeta.title: Birthday imagery inside alien examination
evidence: developer comment: birthday stuff would pop up
L7_mothership_zeta.boundary: This supports a birthday/examination design parallel, not a claim that Zetans caused the Lone Wanderer's birth.

L8_james_memory.title: Identity persistence through session/memory architecture
L8_james_memory.critical_gap: James-specific persisted payload → carrier binding remains unestablished.

L9_janus_bear.title: Object memory / witness / interrupted childhood
L9_janus_bear.boundary: Spatial enrichment must survive cell stratification, geometry controls and lifecycle analysis before global grammar is admitted.

crossings.parallel: microscopic event changes coupled degrees of freedom and leaves macroscopic records
persistent/observable environmental and instrumental changes may alter what is detected/reported
birthday imagery is explicitly linked by development residue to alien examination
crossings.boundary: does not establish alien orchestration of birth

crossings.parallel: identity transitions in childhood are echoed by later questions of memory/session continuity
childhood, absence, death and objects that outlive subjects
events leave persistent records in matter, memory architecture, or staged objects
crossings.nonclaim: these are different media, not the same physical mechanism

critical_reanalysis.finding: One 2026 critical analysis reports the nuclear-test timing correlation becomes insignificant after observation-day normalization and identifies dataset-definition/plate-artifact concerns.

counterevidence.finding_1: A 2026 independent replication reports the core nuclear-test/transient association survives its specified controls.
counterevidence.finding_2: A separate 2026 analysis reports a stronger association after adding geomagnetic Kp and lunar-phase controls.
counterevidence.interpretation: The Palomar question is actively contested and therefore must remain an open reanalysis problem, not a settled nuclear/UAP effect.

synthesis_model.core_pattern: EVENT → INTERACTION/MULTIPLICITY → SEPARATION/DECOHERENCE → RECORD → OBSERVER → INTERPRETATION
synthesis_model.physics_reading: A nuclear event can generate correlated quantum degrees of freedom and extensive environmental records; Everett supplies one interpretation in which decohered alternatives can be described as branches.
synthesis_model.fallout_reading: Children of Atom narratively literalize division as world creation.
synthesis_model.uap_reading: The UAP registry asks whether nuclear context changes observed/transient rates after exposure controls.
synthesis_model.memory_reading: James/Pinkerton asks whether a person-specific state can persist across a transformation boundary.
synthesis_model.bear_reading: Teddy/gnome scenes ask whether environmental objects preserve or encode absent human histories.
synthesis_model.identity_reading: Birthday/Capter-life-cycle and James memory work both test how identity persists through transformations.

allowed: Fallout Children of Atom doctrine is a fictional cosmology about division and new universes.
Fission involves quantum correlations/entanglement and decoherence-relevant interactions.
Everettian MWI provides a branching interpretation of universal quantum evolution.
Nuclear events leave persistent physical records.
Nuclear/UAP associations can be preregistered and statistically tested.
Fallout 3 contains independent narrative/production motifs linking birth, identity, memory and transformation.
Cross-registry parallels can be treated as structural hypotheses and test generators.
forbidden_without_new_evidence: fission literally creates independent classical universes as observable objects
nuclear events create galaxies or future universes by ejecting atoms into space
Zetans arranged the Lone Wanderer's birth
James/Bear/gnome correlations prove a hidden actor placed all scenes
a narrative parallel is physical causation

steps: Freeze exact source versions for UAP, nuclear-site and historical Palomar data.
Replicate the original Palomar result and each major independent reanalysis separately.
Run a preregistered exposure-normalized nuclear/UAP model on the CONUS registry.
Add matched non-nuclear military controls and pseudo-event days.
Track environmental persistent records as a separate layer, never as evidence of alternate universes.
Keep Everett interpretation separate from empirical nuclear/UAP association tests.
Intersect only after each individual layer has passed its own admission gate.
Publish a cross-registry synthesis with evidence edges labeled FACT / INTERPRETATION / ANALOGY / OPEN HYPOTHESIS.
